validity.researcher_notes: EOIT exists as the intrastate transmission system in Oklahoma operated by Enable Oklahoma Intrastate Transmission LLC. Enable Midstream Partners LP (the parent entity) was merged into Energy Transfer LP in 2021; the system continues under Energy Transfer. The sheet spelling 'Instrastate' is a typographical error corrected to 'Intrastate' per corporate naming conventions. Pipeline is an existing operating transmission system; no existence concern. The intrastate status means it is not FERC-certificated (FERC jurisdiction applies only to interstate pipelines), so absence from FERC databases is expected. [ORCHESTRATOR AUDIT 2026-09-15] Tier arithmetic corrected (independent True -> False): this record's evidence resolves to 1 distinct publisher(s) (energytransfer.com), and rule 4 counts publishers, not URLs — every EIA release is ONE origin, as are multiple filings by one filer or multiple notices in one docket. The FINDING is unchanged; only the confidence claim was wrong.
